description: Publish a draft blog post, making it live on the site. Requires confirm: true. On a 2026-07-28 connection whose client declares form elicitation you may omit it and the user confirms in a dialog; anywhere else, omitting it fails. Publishing a scheduled post publishes it immediately and clears the schedule. Pass override_brand_voice: true to bypass the brand-voice gate when a publish fails that check.

confirm.description: Pass true to confirm this action once the user has approved it.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

id.description: UUID of the draft post to publish.

override_brand_voice.description: Set true to publish even though the post fails the brand-voice check. Recorded on the post.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

name: post_posts_by_id_publish
title: Post Posts by ID Publish
